priorityList: Use Shadowstrike if Darkest Night is active (at 4 or fewer targets) or if Unseen Blade is supercharged, provided Secret Technique is on cooldown and Shadow Techniques stacks are high.
Spend combo points on Secret Technique as your highest priority finisher, especially while Shadow Dance is active.
Use Eviscerate as your finisher whenever the Darkest Night buff is active.
Spend combo points on Coup de Grace if Secret Technique is on cooldown or Shadow Dance is active.
Use Black Powder as your primary finisher when 3 or more targets are present (2 or more if Potent Powder is talented).
Activate Shadow Blades when Shadow Dance and Secret Technique are both ready to be used.
Use Shadow Dance if you are not in stealth and Secret Technique is ready, or if Darkest Night is up, or during Shadow Blades.
Use Vanish to generate combo points and trigger Subterfuge if you are not in a stealth state and at 1 or fewer combo points.
Use Shuriken Storm as your primary combo point builder whenever 2 or more targets are present.
Use Goremaw's Bite if you need to generate combo points and have a deficit of at least 3.
Use Shadowstrike as a builder if there are 3 or fewer targets or if you need to apply Deathstalker's Mark (if talented).
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials to sync with Shadow Blades and Shadow Dance windows.
Use Arcane Torrent if energy is low to assist with resource management.
Spend combo points on Eviscerate as a fallback finisher if Secret Technique is on cooldown and you have fewer than 3 targets.
